purpose: Falsify three economically distinct cross-sectional mechanisms without contaminating beta45 or expanding the search after results.

data.survivorship_warning: Fixed present liquid universe; historical results do not remove survivorship risk.

same_weekday_seasonality.hypothesis: An asset's mean return on the same weekday in prior weeks positively predicts its cross-sectional return on the next occurrence of that weekday.
same_weekday_seasonality.score: at completed close t, identify the UTC weekday of execution day t+1 and average the asset's strictly prior close-to-close returns from the last N occurrences of that execution weekday
same_weekday_seasonality.direction: long highest two scores; short lowest two

low_idiosyncratic_volatility.hypothesis: After removing BTC market exposure, lower residual volatility earns higher subsequent cross-sectional return than higher residual volatility.
low_idiosyncratic_volatility.factor_model: OLS with intercept of alt daily returns on BTC daily returns using strictly prior completed observations
low_idiosyncratic_volatility.score: sample standard deviation of OLS residuals over lookback
low_idiosyncratic_volatility.direction: long lowest two residual-volatility assets; short highest two

intraday_skewness.hypothesis: Lower realized return skewness predicts higher next-day cross-sectional return than higher realized skewness.
intraday_skewness.score: sample skewness of strictly prior completed 4h log returns within the lookback window, using bars ending no later than the completed daily signal boundary
intraday_skewness.direction: long lowest two skewness scores; short highest two

family_falsification_gate.selection_if_family_passes: among variants belonging to an adjacent 1.5x-cost-positive neighborhood, select the upper median parameter; never select by maximum PnL

evidence_boundary.positive_sprint_result_only_allows: new frozen candidate followed by D2/D3/D4 and independent-engine replication
